description: In names_match, the forward pass calls ava_values_match(&a_ava.value, &b_ava.value) and the reverse pass calls ava_values_match(&b_ava.value, &a_ava.value). Since ava_values_match is symmetric, this is not a bug. But the inconsistency is a review red-flag: a reader who doesn't already know the function is symmetric will spend time convincing themselves the reversed args are intentional. Fix: make the reverse pass call ava_values_match(&a_ava.value, &b_ava.value) consistently (find a_ava matching b_ava, in the standard argument order).
title: names_match reverse-pass swaps ava_values_match argument order inconsistently
